evidence: A held-out target has no SVD factor row.
observation: A held-out target has no SVD factor row, so its factor is smoothed from PPI, ligand-Jaccard and GO-Jaccard neighbours at beta = 1.0. Smoothing lifts degree-matched cold-target AUPRC above both the base feature model and the unsmoothed SVD.
subject: F-52
title: PPI/ligand/GO factor smoothing rescues cold targets
